meta.title: Deployment Port Collision & Remediation Incident
meta.subtitle: Chronological trace of the NewsLens AI port conflict, container shutdown, port remapping, and successful recovery.

events.title: Initial Compose Deployment
events.detail: Spun up containers binding host ports 8000 and 5173.

events.title: Port Collision Alert (Err 409)
events.detail: Socket bind failed: ports 8000 and 5173 already reserved by NewsLens AI.

events.title: Collision Root Cause Identified
events.detail: Inspected active Docker sockets; found NewsLens AI daemon holding 8000.

events.title: Conflicting Containers Stopped
events.detail: Killed colliding backend/frontend instances to release host sockets.

events.title: Port Remapping Implemented
events.detail: Reconfigured docker-compose.yml to expose backend:8001 and frontend:5174.

events.title: Hot-Reload Containers Relaunched
events.detail: Spun up new compose stack with volume bind mounts and isolated network.

events.title: Health Check Green (200 OK)
events.detail: GET :8001/health confirmed Gemma 4:e4b model connection and ChromaDB ready.

events.title: Incident Closed & Postmortem
events.detail: Both AI Knowledge Assistant and NewsLens AI operate concurrently without port clashes.

cards.title: Initial Conflict
items: Concurrent local dev stacks bound to standard 8000/5173 ports caused socket collision.
Error surfaced immediately as Docker socket bind failure.

cards.title: Resolution Strategy
items: Freed locked host ports without rebooting Docker daemon.
Permanently separated ports: AI Knowledge Assistant (8001/5174) vs NewsLens AI (8000/5173).

cards.title: Verification
items: Independent CORS and proxy configuration confirmed operational.
Full local test suite passed across both isolated environments.
